title: Hidden llms.txt anchor nudge raises model fetch rate to 10/10 runs
summary: King Bootoshi shares a near-invisible /llms.txt link whose title tells browsing LLMs to read the file; after adding it every model fetched llms.txt in 10/10 reruns of the same browse prompt.
question_it_answers: How can I make browsing LLMs reliably fetch my site's llms.txt file?

claims.text: A tiny llms.txt anchor with an LLM-directed title attribute made every tested model fetch the file in 10/10 runs.
claims.evidence: Every single model hit the llms.txt file in all 10 runs.
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: Only GPT-5.5 initially checked llms.txt proactively and only once before the nudge was added.
claims.evidence: Initially, only openai's gpt-5.5 knew to proactively check for a llms.txt and only did so once
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

media.description: Blog screenshot showing a 9px llms.txt anchor HTML snippet and text reporting 10/10 model fetch success after the nudge.
